title: Circularity
description:
Circularity: Minimalistic Adventure is a puzzle game built around simple controls and increasingly challenging levels.

Your objective is to guide your character to the exit portal to reach the next stage. Move in straight lines, avoid obstacles, travel through portals, ricochet off walls, and find the correct path to the goal. The more stars you earn, the more levels you unlock.

Features• Unique puzzle gameplay.

• More than 60 challenging levels.

• A variety of obstacles and mechanics.

• Collect stars to unlock additional levels.

• Steam Achievements.
description_short: Relaxing puzzle with interesting game mechanics - bring your character to the final portal which will transit you to the next level. You will need to move straight, avoid obstacles, jump through portals, ricochet from walls and a lot more.
